summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Excel import and Clear All functionalities. Both features are working correctly from the frontend. User-reported issues appear to be related to data validation errors and user experience rather than technical bugs.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 for unauthenticated requests
minor_issues.impact: Minor - both status codes properly deny access

user_experience_issues.issue: Import validation errors not clearly displayed to users - only shown in browser console
user_experience_issues.impact: Users may think import failed when it's actually validation errors

user_experience_issues.issue: No clear success message when import completes with partial errors
user_experience_issues.impact: Users may not realize some records were imported successfully

action_item_for_main_agent: Both Excel import and Clear All functionalities are working correctly from the frontend. The user's issues are likely due to: 1) Excel file containing duplicate ISIN codes causing validation errors, 2) Import error messages only visible in browser console instead of user-friendly display, 3) Users may not be completing the double confirmation process for Clear All. Consider improving user feedback for import validation errors and success messages.
